cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 26 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 26 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.

ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：上涨趋势。大局（趋势不明）：混合。
points_zh: 大局为混合（对日线多头而言属趋势不明）

ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ UPTREND signal triggered 2 trading days ago (~2026-06-11), switching from DOWNTREND. Signal strength: moderate (score +45/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 上涨趋势信号于 2 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-11），自下跌趋势切换而来。 信号强度：中等（评分 +45/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱买入形态（+21）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

profile.description: Huntington Ingalls Industries, Inc., (HII) is the largest military shipbuilding company in the United States as well as a provider of professional services to partners in government and industry. HII was formed on March 31, 2011, as a divestiture from Northrop Grumman.
profile.description_zh: 亨廷顿英戈尔斯工业公司（HII）是美国最大的军用造船企业，同时为政府和行业合作伙伴提供专业服务。HII于2011年3月31日从诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司剥离成立。
